messages:
Alex Chen: Auditor asked for evidence around the KMS rotation and RBAC changes during the Feb 22 incident. Need: key rotation timeline, KMS audit logs, IAM policy diffs, k8s rolebinding changes, cross-region replication proof, and link to the incident ticket. Who owns which artifacts?
Maria Gomez: I can assemble the pack. We have CloudTrail / KMS audit entries and k8s audit logs. I will need the exact UTC window and the related PR/commit IDs for policy changes. Also auditor wants a signed manifest.
Alex Chen: Window is 2024-02-22 03:12 - 2024-02-22 04:45 UTC (this covers rotation + emergency access). Ticket is IN-2024-67.
Jonathan Patel: PR/commit for the temp RBAC change: https://github.com/redwood/infra/commit/abc123ef - added a rolebinding for svc-account:incident-runner. Approval history is in the PR. I performed the revoke later.
Maria Gomez: For KMS audit extraction you can run (example):
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=ScheduleKeyRotation --start-time 2024-02-22T03:00:00Z --end-time 2024-02-22T05:00:00Z
```
Also filter for ReEncrypt, DisableKeyRotation, CreateGrant, RetireGrant.
Elaine Park: I exported the k8s audit logs + policy diffs and uploaded to s3://redwood-audit/tmp/kms-rotations/2001234567/ . Manifest is at s3://redwood-audit/tmp/kms-rotations/2001234567/manifest.json (sha256: 3f8b9a7e5d2c4b1f9e4c6d2a1b7e8c9d0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c).
sre-bot: evidence-export: completed upload to s3://redwood-audit/tmp/kms-rotations/2001234567/ at 2024-02-22T06:05:23Z :package: 
auditor_jane: Can you include chain-of-custody and say which engineer performed the emergency access grant? We need proof the temporary RBAC was revoked within the documented policy window.
Jonathan Patel: I was on-call. Grant applied at 2024-02-22T03:20Z via terraform apply (plan link: https://ci.redwood/plan/789). Revoke applied at 2024-02-22T04:10Z. Approval thread is in #incidents: https://slack.redwood/archives/INC12345.
Maria Gomez: Added signed manifest (GPG) and screenshots of the approval thread. Chain-of-custody doc uploaded: s3://redwood-audit/chain_of_custody/2001234567.txt (contains list of handlers, timestamps, and export hashes).
auditor_jane: Also need proof that the cross-region KMS replica is identical and active (metadata + replication status).
Alex Chen: We used AWS multi-region CMK. I exported describe-key outputs and get-key-policy for both regions and put them in the same evidence folder.
Elaine Park: Uploaded describe-key + replication status JSONs to s3://redwood-audit/tmp/kms-rotations/2001234567/replication/ . Sample snippet: ```{ \"KeyId\": \"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcde-1234\", \"MultiRegion\": true, \"ReplicaRegions\": [\"eu-west-1\"] }```
auditor_jane: Good. Please include a simple CSV mapping control IDs to the artifacts (e.g., SOC2 CC6.1, ISO A.9.2.1 -> log export / manifest / revoke proof).
Maria Gomez: Draft control mapping created at s3://redwood-audit/control-mappings/2001234567-controls.csv. Excerpt: 
```control_id,description,artifact_path
SOC2-CC6.1,Change control and access revocation,s3://redwood-audit/tmp/kms-rotations/2001234567/manifest.json
ISO-A9.2.1,User access provisioning and deprovisioning,s3://redwood-audit/tmp/kms-rotations/2001234567/rbac-diffs/commit-abc123ef.diff
```
Alex Chen: Once auditor confirms this is sufficient I'll mark the evidence bundle as packaged and attach to IN-2024-67.
auditor_jane: One final ask: can you provide a timestamp attestation signed by our HSM/KMS or an equivalent signed timestamp for the manifest? That helps with chain-of-custody.
Jonathan Patel: Generated HSM attestation and uploaded attestation.pdf to s3://redwood-audit/attestations/2001234567-attestation.pdf. Also included a signed hash of manifest.
auditor_jane: Received. That should be enough for this round. Please notify when the formal evidence bundle is in the compliance bucket.
Maria Gomez: :thumbsup: Packaging now, ETA ~30m. Final bundle path will be s3://redwood-compliance/evidence-bundles/IN-2024-67/2001234567-evidence-bundle.zip and I'll post the signed manifest link here when done.
Alex Chen: Thanks team — once uploaded I'll update the ticket and flag for the auditor.
Maria Gomez: Done — final bundle uploaded to s3://redwood-compliance/evidence-bundles/IN-2024-67/2001234567-evidence-bundle.zip (manifest signed, chain-of-custody attached). Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
